title: Daniel Yoon
text:
Ph.D. Candidate in Political Science | George Washington University
I am a political scientist specializing in International Relations and Iinternational Security. My research examines great power politics in an age of increasing political polarization and democratic erosion.
My dissertation develops a novel theory of strategic exploitation that explains the conditions under which great powers exploit adversaries experiencing domestic political instability, and the conditions under which they refrain from doing so.
My broader research interests include international security, great power competition, strategic restraint, foreign policy decision-making, and the historical foundations of international order.
